common.description: Fields inherited by every top-level resource. The * resource prefix in documentation is not a JSON nesting level.

connection.description: One authorized link to a provider tenant or financial institution.

consent.description: Authorization and permitted use linked to a subject and client.

sync_job.description: Bounded ingestion run, including partial results and source outages.

business.description: A legal organization or sole-proprietor business profile.

person.description: Individual applicant, owner, officer, guarantor or authorized party.

relationship.description: Directed, evidenced link between two entities.

verification.description: KYC or KYB session and its aggregate result.

verification_check.description: Individual document, biometric, address, registry or contact check.

screening_match.description: Candidate watchlist, sanctions, PEP or adverse-media match.

document.description: Evidence file metadata and extraction context.

bank_account.description: Permissioned bank, credit or loan account identity.

account_balance.description: Timestamped balance snapshot; asset and liability meanings remain explicit.

bank_transaction.description: One movement on one financial account; no automatic cross-source deduplication.

recurring_stream.description: Evidence-based grouping of repeated inflows or outflows.

income_observation.description: Income evidence from an entitled income product or an explicitly labeled inference.

merchant_account.description: Merchant processing relationship and settlement context.

payment.description: Payment authorization, capture or collection record.

processor_transaction.description: Ledger event on a processor balance, separate from bank movements.

payout.description: Settlement from a processor or marketplace to a destination account.

refund.description: Return of money linked to a payment or order.

dispute.description: Chargeback or payment dispute and its evidence deadlines.

counterparty.description: Customer or supplier in a commercial source system; not automatically a verified legal entity.

order.description: Commercial sale order with amounts distinct from payment and accounting revenue.

order_line.description: Product or service line belonging to an order.

subscription.description: Recurring commercial contract when the source exposes subscription records.

journal.description: Accounting posting header or source journal entry.

journal_line.description: One debit or credit posting to a ledger account.

invoice.description: Accounts receivable invoice; sale made on credit.

bill.description: Accounts payable invoice; amount owed to a supplier.

credit_note.description: Adjustment reducing a receivable or payable.

accounting_payment.description: Ledger allocation of a customer receipt or supplier payment.

financial_statement.description: Financial report with explicit period, basis and source.

statement_line.description: One classified line of a financial report.

tax_obligation.description: Tax payable or reported obligation from an accounting system or supplied return.

product.description: Catalog item or inventory SKU with ownership and costing context.

location.description: Store, warehouse, branch or operating location.

inventory_balance.description: Quantity and value snapshot by item, location and owner.

inventory_movement.description: A receipt, issue, transfer or adjustment to stock.

purchase_order.description: Supplier purchase commitment, separate from invoices and cash payments.

shipment.description: Physical receipt or dispatch linked to orders and stock.

production_order.description: Manufacturing work order when licensed ERP/MES modules expose it.

project.description: Construction or service job with cost and billing information.

credit_facility.description: Approved credit agreement and aggregate exposure.

loan.description: Loan contract and current servicing state.

repayment.description: A servicing payment event and its allocation.

collateral.description: Asset pledged or proposed to secure an obligation.

covenant.description: Contractual test with a versioned threshold and observed result.

decision.description: Versioned lender decision or AMLOK recommendation with attributable evidence.

lien_search.description: A search request with explicit debtor, jurisdiction and coverage.

lien.description: A security registration or other lien record from a stated registry.

filing_event.description: Amendment, continuation, assignment or termination in a registration chain.

attribute.description: Computed or provider-supplied risk attribute with transparent inputs.

risk_snapshot.description: Immutable assessment at a point in time, preserving subsequent changes separately.

monitor.description: Configured monitoring scope, baseline and refresh policy.

alert.description: Material change or risk signal with evidence and review state.

workflow_run.description: Coordinated execution of Verify, Underwrite, Monitor, Service or Investigate.

requirement.description: Evidence or approval required to complete a workflow.

audit_event.description: Append-only record of actions, versions and access.

reconciliation_link.description: Evidence-based allocation connecting records without collapsing distinct economic events.
